summary: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective through managed exposure to bitcoin futures contracts (“bitcoin futures contracts”) and investments in U.S. Treasury securities. Under normal market conditions, it will invest at least 80% of its assets in Bitcoin Futures Contracts and U.S. Treasury securities. For purposes of compliance with this investment policy, derivative contracts (such as Bitcoin Futures Contracts) will be valued at their notional value. The fund is non-diversified.
